note: EP01 5-second look test (line 01). Builders: an object map in episodes/ep01/test5.js keyed by "shot". Times are frame-snapped (frame = round(t*60)). Board: test5_board.md.

params.beat: the world: a night suburb, a gnome on every lawn, every gnome facing its house
params.angle: up at the sky -> high 3/4 along the lawns

set.gnomes: 1-2 per lot on bed0 / bed1 / lawn0-3 slots (makeFamilyGnome variants, lod mid; Grandpa preset at A1.bed0), all facing their houses (slot yaw), lanterns UNLIT (level 0: plot plant, lit at 41.76 s in the episode)

moon.note: in frame 0, upper third, slightly left of centre

start.note: looks up into the galaxy sky + moon; roof ridges and pine tips only along the bottom edge

move.note: frame 0 is already at full speed; 35% done at 0.1 s, 80% at 0.3 s

push.note: layered on the crane so the shot never settles

events.what: crane at full speed on frame 0
events.sfx: W1 airy whoosh (peak 0.12 s) + A1 crickets bed starts

params.beat: grandparents: an old couple on a porch swing

set.builder: hero lot A1 porch, night (sets.buildLawnCloseup, or buildStreet hero house porch "full" if the swing does not fit the centre porch)
set.swing: NEW PROP: slatted wooden bench 5.5 x 1.6 studs, seat top 1.5 above the deck, back 1.6 tall, two chains to the porch ceiling, painted white (#e9e4da) or the deck wood; fallback: two rockingChair props side by side
set.dressing: front door, lit front window (warm) behind them, wall lantern lit, potted plant, porch rail, Grandpa-gnome NOT visible

camera.pos: swing centre + 9.5 studs along the swing facing rotated +28 deg (front-right), y = deck + 4.4 studs
camera.target: swing centre, y = deck + 3.4 studs (faces in the upper 30-40% of frame)

anim.swing: sway +-2.5 deg at 0.45 Hz about the chain pivots (riders rigid on the seat); humans hold the sit pose

params.beat: don't die: Grandma, perfectly content; her glasses glint on "die"

set.builder: same porch as s02 (same swing, same light)
set.dressing: lit window + wall lantern behind her shoulder, navy edge of Grandpa's cardigan at frame right

camera.pos: Grandma's head centre + 3.2 studs along her facing rotated +20 deg (same side of the axis as s02), y = head centre + 0.05
camera.target: head centre - 0.35 studs (face in the upper 30-40%)

glint.what: one big 4-point star glint on her right lens rim: tex.sparkle points 4, colour #f4ecff, 0 -> 110 px in 3 frames, back to 0 by +16 frames, rotation 0 -> 25 deg; no sound

params.beat: they turn into: a sparkle burst on "turn", both snap into gnomes on the swing

set.builder: same porch and swing as s02

cast.place: standing on the seat where Grandma sat, facing the camera
standing on the seat where Grandpa sat, unlit lantern in his right hand

camera.pos: swing centre + 8.5 studs along the swing facing rotated -20 deg (front-left: Grandma stays frame-left), y = deck + 2.4 studs
camera.target: swing centre, y = deck + 3.2 studs (looks slightly up)

anim.swing: sway +-2.5 deg at 0.45 Hz; at the snap the seat dips 0.15 stud and swings to +-5 deg (anim.springKeys, freq 3 Hz, zeta 0.35)
anim.gnomes: K.gnomeIdle micro sway; eyes open, gaze at the lens

magicDust.what: gold + pink motes and 4-point pink twinkles swirling around the couple, density rising into the burst

burst.what: fx.burst per grandparent at chest height (deck + 3.2 studs): count 30, puff 12, corePx 520 (covers a torso), ring 40 -> 620 px, dur 0.35, colours #ffffff / #e9dcff / #ffe2c4 + a few #ffb0d8
burst.swap: humans hidden and gnomes shown on the burst frame (core brightest): the 1-frame pop is hidden by the burst

fx.dust_after: the puff motes settle until the cut

events.sfx: P1 poof (pop transient 2.240 s) over M1 shimmer swell (from 2.10, peak 2.30)

params.beat: garden GNOMES: the hero creature. Grandpa as a glazed gnome in his flowerbed, from below; silent hold after the line

set.subject: K.makeGnome('grandpa', { lantern: 0 }) at slot A1.bed0, facing the house (slot yaw)
set.dressing: tulips around his boots, flowerbed edging; behind him (toward the street): lawn, picket fence and gate, a lamp post with halo, the houses across with lit windows, galaxy sky behind the hat tip

params.light: nightLawn (P1 high-key) + warm window spill from the bedroom window above and behind the camera (practical #ffd9a0 about 2 cd) as the face key; subject lift on the face (about 0.6 cd warm)

camera.pos: between the gnome and the house wall, 1.7 studs in front of his face, y = 0.9 studs (cull the wall/foundation for this shot if the camera would be inside it)
camera.target: his nose, y = 1.35 studs (pitch about +12 deg, looking up)

anim.gnome: K.gnomeIdle micro sway only; gaze up +10 deg (to the bedroom window above the camera); NO blink, NO head turn, lantern UNLIT (all three are plot devices for later)

magicDust.what: a few gold motes still settling (carry-over from the burst)

events.what: voice ends (silence hold to 5.0 s: crickets + shimmer tail)
